ar.title: مرقة بامية عراقية بالتمر الهندي

steps.n1: قطّع اللحم مكعبات بحجم اللقمة واسلقه مع البهارات حتى ينضج. ارفعه واحتفظ بالمرقة.
steps.n2: حمّر اللحم في السمن، ثم أضف البامية والثوم وقلّب حتى يتحمر الكل جيداً.
steps.n3: ذوّب معجون الطماطم في سائل التمر الهندي، وتبّله، وأضفه إلى الحلة مع المرقة.
steps.n5: ارفعها عن النار وأضف عصير الليمون وقلّب.

en.title: Iraqi Okra Stew with Tamarind (Bamia Marag)
en.intro: Recipe 265, page 119 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cut the mutton into bite-sized cubes and boil with the spices until tender. Lift it out, keeping the broth.
steps.n2: Fry the mutton in ghee, then add the okra and garlic and stir until everything is well fried.
steps.n3: Dissolve the tomato paste in the tamarind liquid, season, and add it to the pot with the broth.
steps.n5: Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.

legacySteps: Cut the mutton into bite-sized cubes and boil with the spices until tender. Lift it out, keeping the broth.
Fry the mutton in ghee, then add the okra and garlic and stir until everything is well fried.
Dissolve the tomato paste in the tamarind liquid, season, and add it to the pot with the broth.
Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
